rejected.reason: Racial-typology illustration with a pending Commons deletion request. Both crops came from this one file, so dana.jpg was rejected too.
Costume/pose image (saree, namaste), and the page carries both {{PD-algorithm}} and {{cc-by-4.0}}.

Licence is fine ({{PD-algorithm}} only, no deletion request), but the casual T-shirt doesn't meet the business/smart-casual rule. It also had lower resolution and a GAN blob in the background. Kept at src/rejected_out/sam.jpg.
Phantom glasses arm at the temple
Dark artefact at the corner of the mouth
No other Commons file met the rules: clean PD-algorithm/CC0 licence only, no deletion request, neutral professional headshot, and the needed apparent ethnicities.
